name: Aurora gradient photo
looks: A soft diagonal wash of two or three brand colours sits inside an interface mock-up where a photograph would normally go. It reads as imagery without needing a real photo or a real person, and it drifts gently so the panel never looks static.
build: Build it as a canvas linear or conic gradient in the brand's colours with seeded grain noise, or as stacked CSS gradients with blend modes. Drift the gradient's angle and stops slowly as a function of time so the image stays alive.
prompt: Wherever a mock-up or panel needs a stand-in photograph, fill it instead with a slow, drifting gradient wash in two or three of the brand's colours plus a touch of grain. It should read as imagery at a glance without depicting any real person or sourced photo, and its angle or colour stops should shift gently over the shot so it feels alive rather than painted on.
